gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: During 2014 the syndicate experienced adverse prior-year reserve movements, with narrative disclosure citing prior year movements of GBP 5.8m (principally adverse movements of GBP 5.4m in claims reserving). The deterioration was driven largely by liability awards in the UK and Canada (and to a lesser extent Ireland), a settlement on a 2010 case forced by reinsurers, and movements associated with a RITC carried forward from the 2011 close. This prior year strengthening represents a material increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding (approximately +20.7%).

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: No explicit standalone 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note with a clear gross claims movement was available in the provided pages. The prior_year_development_gbp_m is taken from narrative disclosures ('Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m' and 'GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving') and interpreted as a gross adverse movement. There is some ambiguity whether amounts quoted are gross or net of reinsurance for certain lines and some currency-denominated movements are reported in non-GBP currencies; amounts have not been converted. RITC effects are noted and may distort reserve movement comparability.
